mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a strong economic expansion, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a potential slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of strong economic expansion periods when GDPC1 declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
